info.name: OrderSphere - Feature Coverage
info.description:
Assertion-based coverage of every implemented feature listed in CLAUDE.md that the Full Order Flow collection doesn't already exercise: auth & RBAC, inventory catalog/restock/stock limits, hosted checkout (payment idempotency, card validation, cancellation, webhook signature checks), shipment returns, notification preferences and delivery, service discovery, the RabbitMQ topology, and circuit breaker registration.

Run top to bottom (`npx newman run postman/feature-coverage.postman_collection.json`) against the docker-compose stack. Every run uses fresh users/SKU suffixed with {{runId}}, so it is re-runnable. Async steps poll themselves (3s, up to 20 tries).

The RabbitMQ requests use the docker-compose default management credentials (ordersphere/ordersphere).
